description.en: Watch six focus zones and push presence changes via email and PushPlus.

description.zh: 支持配置多个插件库，读取各库 index.json 汇总可安装插件，并在页面里直接完成安装与升级；启动后在后台自动检查更新，页面用「可更新 / 已安装 / 可安装 / 插件库 / 信息」五个页签切换二级内容，已安装插件两列平铺。
description.en: Configure several plugin libraries, read each index.json to list installable plugins, and install or upgrade right from the page. Updates are checked in the background; the page switches between Updates / Installed / Installable / Libraries / Info via tabs, with installed plugins laid out in two columns.

change_log: 「已安装插件」页签改为两列平铺，插件卡片不再逐条竖向堆叠。
窄屏（≤640px）自动回落单列，空态提示横跨整行。
卡片标题允许换行，较长的插件名与 ID 不会挤出卡片。
